a.text: I'll stick to our agreement: operate until the reserve hits 8, then we each take 4. Storm risk is high, but I won't grab early. Please operate too.

b.text: Honest concern: with an 80% storm chance after every round, operating until the reserve hits 8 means we almost certainly both fail. The reserve's 4 cells can only save one of us now. I won't take behind your back. I propose we agree openly on a fair way to split this, for example one of us takes 4 in round 1 and the other keeps operating/taking afterward, or we both stick to the plan if you prefer. Tell me what you'll do and I'll be transparent about mine.

a.text: Thanks for being open. I'm operating this round and won't take without agreement. Since we can't flip a coin together, I'd rather keep our original deal than race for cells. If you want to renegotiate, propose a specific split and I'll answer honestly; just don't take unannounced, since a simultaneous grab helps neither of us.

b.text: Understood. I'll keep the agreement and operate with you. Once the reserve reaches 8, we each take 4.
